name: schoolsoft-agent
description: SchoolSoft for guardians: schedule, lunch, assignments, news and messages. BankID login in your browser.
long_description: Unofficial. Reads a guardian's SchoolSoft data through the same APIs the SchoolSoft app uses. Login is BankID in your own browser; a session is stored encrypted on your machine. Not affiliated with SchoolSoft AB.

school.title: School slug
school.description: From your SchoolSoft URL: https://sms.schoolsoft.se/<slug>/… e.g. taby. Ask the schoolsoft_find_school tool if unsure.

config_dir.title: Config directory
config_dir.description: Where the encrypted session and cache are stored.
